item.title: Yamaguchi City Culture and Arts Center — Guide
item.description: Yamaguchi city, the prefectural capital, has long prided itself on culture, once nicknamed the ‘Kyoto of the West’ for its refinement in the medieval era. Today that spirit continues in its modern cultural and arts facilities, which host changing exhibitions, concerts and performances, and programmes of international exchange, all in a contemporary setting in the heart of the city. For travellers, a stop here offers a glimpse of the region’s living cultural scene beyond its historic temples and gardens — a chance to catch an exhibition or event, learn about local arts, and see how a quiet provincial capital keeps its long cultural tradition alive in the present day.
